item.title: Portland man who killed twin brother outside motel lobby sentenced
item.description: Martre Oliver was sentenced to 12.5 years in prison for shooting and killing his twin brother, Martese, in Portland on September 5, 2022.

item.title: Oregon residents have among the highest levels of stress in the US, study finds
item.description: Oregon ranked 8th in the nation for stress levels, with family, money, and health related stress being the highest contributors, according to a new WalletHub study.

item.title: Supporting women in the workforce is key to Portland metro's 'path forward': report
item.description: A new report from the Portland Metro Chamber found that the region has made progress for women participating in the workforce, however "urgent" work is needed to support women in the workforce and boost the local economy.
